text: So what A actually does is to hear a signal from B, but it cannot, because of a channel error, demodulate correctly what B is transmitting. So we are in a lucky case where suddenly the wireless channel between A and B deteriorates due to multipath fading, for example. So as Mark here, A in this unfortunate situation will sense the channel as busy because it can hear B, of course. But as I said, we have an error in the modulation stage, and A cannot extract the value of the duration field correctly. So if I cannot read the duration field, clearly I cannot set the now, right? So what A will do during this time is to have the physical sensing, the physical layer sensing function saying the channel is busy. But at the MAC layer, A cannot set the now. So the virtual sensing function at the MAC layer will say channel idle. So we have a mismatch between what the physical layer sensing function says and what the MAC layer function says. So in this case, A is like us when we hear.
